name: Stop & Shop Plaza
summary: Stop & Shop Plaza is a grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping center located at 54 Hazard Avenue in Enfield, Connecticut. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, this convenient plaza serves the Greater Hartford area with essential retail services and ample parking for local residents.
demographics: Stop & Shop Plaza serves the Enfield, Connecticut community in Hartford County, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area draws from households with moderate to above-average incomes who value convenience and accessibility for their everyday shopping needs. Typical visitors include busy parents, retirees, and local residents seeking grocery shopping and essential services in a familiar, easily accessible location. The center benefits from Enfield's stable residential population and its position along major thoroughfares that connect to nearby communities in the Greater Hartford area.
description: Stop & Shop Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 54 Hazard Avenue in Enfield, Connecticut, serving the Greater Hartford area with essential retail and services. Anchored by a Stop & Shop supermarket, this plaza provides local residents with a reliable destination for grocery shopping and everyday needs in an accessible, open-air format. The center's strategic location in Enfield positions it as a convenient stop for families and professionals throughout the community, offering ample parking and easy access from major roadways. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, Stop & Shop Plaza benefits from professional management and a commitment to serving neighborhood retail needs.
